result.summary: All 4 PLC test files compile and migrations apply (145/145), but 23/27 tests fail at runtime with PoolError.QueryFailed -> ModuleCatalogError.TransactionFailed. Root cause: src/repository/process_module_catalog.zig:170 embeds the status literal as '\''DRAFT'\'' inside a Zig raw string, producing invalid SQL '\''DRAFT'\'' in PostgreSQL (verified: psql returns 'syntax error at or near \'). This is a production-code SQL defect, NOT the migration scope-casing issue from ae0840b3 (which is correctly resolved). ORCH must spawn WF-03 ISSUE-FIXER to patch the SQL literal.

issues.description: src/repository/process_module_catalog.zig:170 SQL literal syntax error: VALUES clause contains '\''DRAFT'\'' (embedded backslashes from Zig raw-string escape), causing PostgreSQL 'syntax error at or near \'. Affects every INSERT into public.process_module_catalog, which is the entry point for all 27 PLC tests. Fix: replace with bare 'DRAFT' or pass status as $7 parameter.
issues.verified_via: docker-compose exec -T db_test psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c "SELECT '\''DRAFT'\'';" returns 'ERROR: syntax error at or near \"\"'
